description: Nexora Radial is an Arabic-first radial bar chart for Power BI, built with full right-to-left (RTL) support. It compares a handful of categories as clean circular arcs, with the total or average sitting in the middle — so the comparison carries its own context in a compact space. Key features: - Radial arcs with adjustable thickness, spacing and angles, plus an optional background track. - Center metric: total or average with a custom label. - Arc labels with a configurable halo so they stay readable over any color. - The official Power BI legend with native Arabic support and multiple positions. - Color modes: single color, gradient between a low and a high value, up to eight colors, or the report theme palette. - Number formatting: number, percent and currency — including the official Saudi Riyal symbol (U+20C1). - Selection and cross-filtering to the rest of the page. - Arabic/English localization and full font control. Everything runs inside your report: no external services, no network calls, no telemetry — your data never leaves Power BI. Ideal for: comparing categories in a compact space, ranking top and bottom performers, showing each category's share of the total, and adding a clear circular element to an executive dashboard.
